en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Saeed Bin Janaah, 
(It has been narrated) from a slave of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> who said,

‘He<sup>asws</sup> called for dates, so he<sup>asws</sup> ate them, then said: ‘There is no desire with me<sup>asws</sup> but I<sup>asws</sup> have eaten fish’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who sleeps and in his inside is a fish, and he does not follow it up with dates or honey, the vein of leprosy would not cease to strike upon him until the morning’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Sa‘id ibn Janah from a Mawla of abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once asked for dates and ate it; then said, ‘I have no appetite for it but it is because I just ate fish. He (the Imam) then said, ‘If one goes to sleep for the night and there is fish in his stomach after which he has not made a few dates or honey to follow it the vein of paralysis continues to beat on him until the morning.’”
